content:
maria: Quick question — for the upcoming private deploy audit, where should WAF events live? team wants them in Splunk HEC but we also need KMS key IDs surfaced for correlation with encrypted artifacts. cc @chris @ben :eyes:
chris: We currently forward WAF -> syslog-ng -> forwarder -> Splunk HEC. KMS metadata is not part of the WAF payload today.
ben: We could enrich logs at the forwarder stage with the envelope key id. forwarder already has access to the keystore service, so add a small enrichment hook.
sam: Are we comfortable with the forwarder having keystore read access? That expands blast radius. Might be better to add only a key-id signer endpoint that returns the key id, no decrypt perms.
maria: Good call. Prefer minimal perms. Proposal: forwarder calls internal /keystore/key-metadata (kms-reader) which returns only {"key_id": "alias/priv-deploy-01"} and we stamp logs. No plaintext keys leave keystore.
nathan_ops: That works. We'll need an RBAC change: add role `keystore.metadata-reader` to the forwarder service account. Can someone open the iam PR?
ben: I'll open it. Also we should include request/tracing id so Splunk can join WAF events with token-store ops.
chris: For Splunk ingestion, use JSON logs with fields: `request_id`, `waf_rule`, `key_id`, `src_ip`, `action`. Example payload we can send from forwarder:
```json
{
  "ts": "2026-04-12T14:22:01Z",
  "request_id": "req_3f9a1",
  "waf_rule": "sql_injection_block",
  "action": "blocked",
  "key_id": "alias/priv-deploy-01",
  "src_ip": "10.2.4.8"
}
```
maria: Nice. Two follow-ups: (1) audit retention for those logs (we need 2 years for regulated customers). (2) proof we didn't leak keys during recent vuln triage.
sam: On retention — Splunk retention policy can be set per index. ops: create index `priv_audit_waf` with cold-hot retention 2y.
nathan_ops: Will do. For the vuln triage: which CVE are we mapping to this? I saw an alert about the WAF upgrade and a potential header-parsing vuln.
maria: CVE-2026-1029 (example) — we patched the WAF last week. Need to produce evidence the patch didn't expose key material or log sensitive headers.
ben: I pulled a sample of post-patch logs. No key material present. Only key_id. Also forwarder logs show only metadata fetch calls: `GET /keystore/key-metadata?alias=priv-deploy-01` 200.
chris: To be thorough, we should add a small audit-runbook entry: steps to produce reproducible evidence for compliance. Rough draft: 1) export Splunk query for events with `key_id` and `request_id` range 2) show forwarder call logs to keystore 3) show keystore access logs (who called metadata-reader role) 4) include KMS CMK rotation history.
maria: Perfect. Can someone add that to the private-deploy runbook? I'll attach the Splunk query snippet.
ben: Adding to runbook now. Splunk query (rough): `index=priv_audit_waf sourcetype=json key_id=alias/priv-deploy-01 | stats count by waf_rule, action`
sam: Also update RBAC change ticket with automated tests: a smoke test that asserts forwarder cannot call Decrypt endpoints. Use CI to call both metadata and decrypt endpoints with SA token.
nathan_ops: I'll add test to infra-ci. We should gate the RBAC PR with the CI smoke test.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3957 — WAF upgrade review (assigned to @maria, @ben).
maria: Thanks. Final ask: ops, make sure Splunk index audit logs are exported to long-term archive (S3 with SSE-KMS) and include the CMK arn in the archive manifest so auditors can tie it back.
chris: We will use envelope-encryption with our account CMK and include `archive_manifest.json` with `cmk_arn` and `start_ts`/`end_ts`.
ben: I'll include a sample manifest and push to the runbook.
maria: Great. If nobody objects I'll proceed with IAM PR and runbook edits. :thumbsup:
sam: No objections.
chris: Go for it.
maria: Opening the iam PR and pinging here when it's ready.
ben: PR link: https://git.company/repo/pulls/482 (rbac: forwarder -> keystore.metadata-reader)
maria: Got it. I'll update the compliance checklist and post evidence in the runbook. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
